flub.definition:
n an embarrassing mistake
v make a mess of, destroy or ruin
flub.translation:
vt. 搞坏, 弄糟
vi. 瞎搞, 犯错误, 失败
n. 搞坏, 胡弄, 错误

flubbed.definition: v make a mess of, destroy or ruin
flubbed.translation: v. 搞坏( flub的过去式和过去分词 ); 把…搞得一团糟; 做得不好; 弄糟

flubbing.definition: v make a mess of, destroy or ruin
flubbing.translation: v. 搞坏( flub的现在分词 ); 把…搞得一团糟; 做得不好; 弄糟

flubdub and gulf.translation: 夸张的空话, 胡说八道

flubdubbed.translation: a. <美俚>笨拙的, 易犯错误的

flubenzimine.translation: [化] 氟苯亚胺噻唑(杀螨剂)

flubs.definition:
n an embarrassing mistake
v make a mess of, destroy or ruin
flubs.translation: v. 搞坏( flub的第三人称单数 ); 把…搞得一团糟; 做得不好; 弄糟
